text:
Riders Republic: 5th Anniversary Livestream
Tune in to celebrate Riders Republic's 5th Anniversary with announcements, special guests and more!

About Riders Republic:
Jump into a massive extreme sports multiplayer open-world across America’s National Parks. From bike races to snow parks and more, your journey starts now! Immerse yourself in iconic American national parks including Bryce Canyon, Yosemite Valley, Mammoth Mountain. Play solo or squad up with your friends and compete in a wide range of events, or give it your best shot in epic mass PvP races with 50+ other players.

#Ubisoft #RidersRepublic

Born for the unexpected 🏁
Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato is coming to Motorfest. Take it off the beaten path and experience Lamborghini like never before.

Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato, available tomorrow in #TheCrewMotorfest

author: Ubisoft YouTube
text:
The Crew Motorfest: Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato
A 610 CV V10. 44 mm more ground clearance. Rally mode. All-wheel drive. The Huracán Sterrato was built to take Lamborghini performance beyond the asphalt 

Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato, available in #TheCrewMotorfest on October 21

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!
